response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Poem, second stanza, fourth line","severity":"major","source_quote":"Claiming His love on me overlying.","suggested_fix":"Replace the line with “En maak aanspraak op sy liefde wat oor my rus.” This preserves the source’s idea of claiming his love rather than trusting in it.","translation_quote":"En vertrou op sy liefde wat oor my rus."},{"location":"Poem, eighth stanza, third line","severity":"major","source_quote":"Yet the promise remains, all works out well,","suggested_fix":"Replace the line with “Tog bly die belofte staan: alles loop goed af,” to retain the source’s assurance that things turn out well, without changing it to the distinct claim that everything works for good.","translation_quote":"Tog bly die belofte staan: alles werk ten goede uit,"},{"location":"Poem, eleventh stanza, first line","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Sometimes I find myself dreaming,","suggested_fix":"Replace with “Soms betrap ek myself dat ek droom,” for idiomatic Afrikaans.","translation_quote":"Soms vind ek myself droom,"},{"location":"Poem, eleventh stanza, fourth line","severity":"minor","source_quote":"To hear those words, “Well done.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “Goed gedaan” with the idiomatic Afrikaans “Mooi so” in the quotation: “Om daardie woorde te hoor: ‘Mooi so.’”","translation_quote":"Om daardie woorde te hoor: “Goed gedaan.”"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
